name: Indian FIR Report Intake
description: A configurable FIR intake workflow for capturing complainant details, incident facts, accused context, and witness information before generating a filled report packet.

schema.label: Complainant full name
schema.default_question: What is the complainant's full name?
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm the complainant's full name exactly as it should appear in the FIR.
schema.help_text: Use the complainant's legal name if available.

schema.label: Complainant phone number
schema.default_question: What phone number should the police use to contact the complainant?
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm the complainant's phone number.

schema.label: Complainant address
schema.clarification_question: Please provide the complainant's full address.

schema.label: Incident date
schema.default_question: On what date did the incident happen?
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm the incident date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

schema.label: Incident time
schema.default_question: At what time did the incident happen?

schema.label: Incident location
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm the incident location with enough detail for the FIR.

schema.label: Police station
schema.default_question: Which police station should receive this FIR?
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm the police station name.

schema.label: Incident category
schema.default_question: What kind of incident is being reported?
schema.clarification_question: Please choose the closest incident category for the FIR.

schema.label: Incident summary
schema.default_question: Please describe what happened in a concise incident summary.
schema.clarification_question: Please provide a clear summary of the reported incident.

schema.label: Accused known to complainant
schema.default_question: Is the accused known to the complainant?
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm whether the accused is known to the complainant.

schema.label: Accused details
schema.default_question: What details do you have about the accused?
schema.clarification_question: Please share any identifying details for the accused.

schema.label: Witnesses present
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm whether any witnesses were present.

schema.label: Witness details
schema.default_question: What witness details should be recorded?
schema.clarification_question: Please share the witness names or contact details that should be recorded.

schema.label: Estimated loss in INR
schema.default_question: What is the estimated loss amount in INR, if any?
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm the estimated loss amount in INR.

field_groups.label: Complainant
field_groups.description: Identity and contact details for the complainant.

field_groups.label: Incident Details
field_groups.description: When, where, and what happened in the reported incident.

field_groups.label: Accused Information
field_groups.description: Whether the accused is known and any identifying details.

field_groups.label: Witnesses And Loss
field_groups.description: Witness presence and any reported property or monetary loss.
